from fractions import Fraction as F
M=(0,0);N=(4,0);P=(1,3);O=(5,3);Q=(8,0)
# R on PQ and on ON: P+t(Q-P)=N+s(O-N)
import sympy as sp
t,s=sp.symbols('t s')
sol=sp.solve([P[0]+t*(Q[0]-P[0])-N[0]-s*(O[0]-N[0]),P[1]+t*(Q[1]-P[1])-N[1]-s*(O[1]-N[1])],[t,s])
sv=sol[s]
r=(sv,1-sv)
assert r==(sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,2))
assert r!=(sp.Rational(1,3),sp.Rational(2,3))
assert r!=(sp.Rational(3,4),sp.Rational(1,4))
assert r!=(sp.Rational(2,3),sp.Rational(1,3))

r=s[a]+s[b]

ch='A'
